inlines.v: REP'ARABLE, adjective [Latin reparabilis. See Repair.] 1. That may be repaired or restored to a sound or good state; as, a house or wall is not reparable 2. That may be retrieved or made good; as, the loss is reparable 3. That may be supplied by an equivalent; as a reparable injury.
